caption: The drawing depicts two textile objects against a plain beige background: an upper garment, possibly a shawl or capelet, and a matching, wide, curved panel that could be an accessory or lower garment. Both pieces are a rich, deep blue in color and are bordered with a black lace trim. The upper garment is open in the front, has short, wide sleeves, and features black lace along all its edges. Both sides have vertical floral decorations composed of green stems, small leaves, and multicolored flowers in shades of pink, blue, white, and yellow. The curved panel at the bottom is similarly blue with a black lace border, and it displays a matching floral motif along the lower edge, mirroring the decorative elements on the upper piece. The lace is depicted as fine, openwork in a net-like pattern and frames both objects consistently. The background is plain, with no additional objects or decorative elements.
title: Shoulder Cape
